How payment works

Payment is split in three parts: 50% to start, 25% as the work progresses in step with what is done, and the final 25% on completion. You never pay for work that has not happened.

Keeping it live: the monthly costs

Complete handoff: $40 CAD per month. This covers hosting for all backend services (database, logins, file storage, backups, security and SSL, email sending) and includes the AI-assisted builder, so the site keeps running and you can keep updating it yourself. Monthly costs are subject to change.

Some yearly or extra fees may apply and are passed through at cost: domain renewal, email hosting, extra storage, heavy AI use, premium SSL, and payment processing fees if you take payments online.

Domain and email

We set the site up on a domain you own, and can set up matching business email on that domain. The domain stays registered in your name.

Search basics

The site ships with the basics search engines need: page titles and descriptions, your services and neighbourhood named clearly, and your hours and address marked up so Google can show them properly.

Ownership

The website and its content are yours. You own the site, the words, and the photos you provide. Nothing is held back if you ever move on.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Before you book

Short answers. Anything else, ask Ahura at your consultation.

Does laser hair removal hurt?+
Most clients describe it as a quick snap, like a light elastic band on the skin. It is over fast, area by area, and you can ask for a pause at any point. Ahura checks in as he works.
How many sessions will I need?+
Hair grows in cycles, and laser only treats hair in its active growth phase, so one session is never the whole job. Most men book a series of sessions for an area. At your first visit, Ahura looks at your hair type and talks through a realistic plan.
Is there any downtime?+
For most treatments, no. You can head straight back to work or the gym. Skin can look a little red for a short while after a session, which is normal and settles on its own.
How do I book?+
Book online any time on the booking page, or call 437-989-5290. The studio runs evening hours most days, including weekends until 11 PM, so appointments after work are easy to get.
